question:
Match India’s neighbouring countries in column A with their official languages in column B.

 
 

 
 
**Column A**

 
**(Country names)**

 
 
 
**Column B**

 
**(Official Languages)**

 
 
 

 
 
1.

 
 
 
Sri Lanka

 
 
 
a.

 
 
 
Mandarin

 
 
 

 
 
2.

 
 
 
China

 
 
 
b.

 
 
 
Burmese

 
 
 

 
 
3.

 
 
 
Myanmar

 
 
 
c.

 
 
 
Tamil

 
 
 

 
 
4.

 
 
 
Bhutan

 
 
 
d.

 
 
 
Dzongkha
solution:
The correct answer is __**1-c, 2-a, 3-b, 4-d**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 4** correctly matches the countries with their official languages:
 
• Sri Lanka - Tamil
 
• China - Mandarin
 
• Myanmar - Burmese
 
• Bhutan - Dzongkha

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The official languages of these countries are integral to their cultural and administrative identity.
 
• Sri Lanka has two official languages: Sinhala and Tamil, but Tamil is the correct match in this context.
 
• Mandarin is the official language of China and is the most spoken language in the world.
 
• Burmese is the official language of Myanmar, also known as Burma.
 
• Dzongkha is the official language of Bhutan and is used in government and education.
